title: gemini-3.5-flash is defined in Gemini CLI model configuration but is not available for selection or use

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue is a clear, actionable bug report detailing that gemini-3.5-flash is defined in the model configuration but is unavailable in the model selection menu and fails with a 404 access error when invoked via gemini --model gemini-3.5-flash using Google OAuth / Code Assist authentication (LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE). Complete reproduction details, environment information, and error messages are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix involves updating isGemini31LaunchedForAuthType in packages/core/src/config/config.ts to include AuthType.LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE and AuthType.COMPUTE_ADC, enabling hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() to evaluate to true for personal OAuth users. This is a localized configuration logic change with straightforward unit test coverage in packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts.

summary.problem: gemini-3.5-flash is defined in the model configuration but is not available in the model selection menu or via the --model flag when using personal OAuth authentication (LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE).
summary.root_cause: isGemini31LaunchedForAuthType in packages/core/src/config/config.ts excludes AuthType.LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE and AuthType.COMPUTE_ADC, causing hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() to return false and fallback model resolutions to fail.
summary.context: For LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE authentication, gemini-3.5-flash should be enabled and mapped via CCPA_AI_MODEL_MAPPINGS to gemini-3-flash on backend requests.

steps: Update isGemini31LaunchedForAuthType in packages/core/src/config/config.ts to include AuthType.LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE and AuthType.COMPUTE_ADC.
Ensure hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() evaluates to true for LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE auth type, properly setting flash model defaults and allowing gemini-3.5-flash selection.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() returns true for LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE auth type without requiring experiment flags, enabling gemini-3.5-flash in model configuration.
verification_steps: Add unit test in packages/core/src/config/config.test.ts to confirm hasGemini35FlashGAAccess() returns true for AuthType.LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE.
Verify that DEFAULT_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL and PREVIEW_GEMINI_FLASH_MODEL are both updated to gemini-3.5-flash for LOGIN_WITH_GOOGLE auth.
